document.name: Review purchase requests
document.description: Example: an agent assesses a purchase request against the vendor's record; large or risky purchases go to an organization admin to approve, small ones wait for the next ordering window, and approved ones are ordered. Start it with a request, or link it to an event type on Events.

config.instructions: Read the purchase request and the vendor's record. Say what the spend is for, whether it fits the justification, and how risky it is.

config.message: {{ input.request.requester }} asks to buy {{ input.request.item }} for {{ input.request.amount }} dollars from {{ input.request.vendor }}. {{ steps.assess.output.summary }} Approve the purchase?
